title: Mobile QA Test Run Result
description: Schema for test execution result files generated by the mobile-automator-executor skill.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier in format run_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS

schema_version.description: Version of the scenario schema used for this test run.

scenario_id.description: ID of the scenario that was executed

app_version.description: App version at time of execution

api_level.description: Android API level or iOS version

captured_variables.description: Variables captured during test execution via capture_value steps. Keys are variable names declared in the scenario's 'variables' block.

screenshot.description: Path to captured screenshot for this step

retried.description: Whether this step was retried due to suspected flakiness

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts made for this step (0 = no retries)

step_duration_ms.description: Actual time taken to execute this step in milliseconds

condition_evaluated.description: Result of the step's condition evaluation. null if no condition was set.

sub_steps_executed.description: Execution results for nested sub-steps (if this step had sub_steps)

observations.description: DEPRECATED — use the run-level `observations` array, which is typed. Retained for result files written before typed observations; no writer populates it.

actual_screenshot.description: Path to screenshot captured during execution

type.description: Observer trait that generated this observation

observations.description: Observations from observer traits (regression spotter, flakiness detector, state detective)

measurements.description: Facts MEASURED from the run's event trace (mobile-automator/.logs/run-<run_id>.ndjson) rather than self-reported by the executing agent. Absent when no trace was available — MAUTO_RUN_ID unset, logging silenced, no workspace, or a run id that could not name a file.

source.description: Where duration_seconds came from: measured from the trace, taken from --duration, or neither.

reported_duration_seconds.description: What --duration claimed, retained even when the measured value was written to duration_seconds instead.

duration_disagreement.description: True when the reported and measured durations differ by more than the tolerance. The disagreement is itself a signal and is recorded rather than silently resolved.

trace_events.description: Number of events in the run trace.

device_failures.description: Device-kind and timeout-kind verb failures recorded during the run. Every one is an attempt that did not take.

trace_truncated.description: True when the trace reached its size cap, so the measured duration is a lower bound rather than the run's full span.

failure_screenshots.description: Screenshots captured automatically at device failures during this run.

crashes.description: App crash reports observed during this run. Present only when at least one was observed, so a clean run's file is unchanged. Populated by `mauto result add-crash`, typically from `mauto crash list`.

crash_id.description: Device-local report id; pass to `mauto crash get` for the full report

process.description: Package/bundle identifier of the process that died

timestamp.description: The device's own time for the report, when it reports one

detected_at.description: ISO time at which mauto observed the report

step_id.description: Step in flight when the crash was observed

excerpt.description: Bounded head of the crash report (max 2000 chars); the full report lives at report_path

report_path.description: Path to the full report written by `mauto crash get --out`
